join hortbot 999 foobar 1

clock_set 2000-10-01T03:11:22Z


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command exec
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !command exec <command string>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command exec The current time is (_TIME_).
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The current time is 3:11 AM.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command exec (_TESTING_ERROR_)
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 mod/2 access=moderator :!command exec Hello, (_USER_).
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello, mod.
